=== parse-lighthouse-json-floors-decimal-scores-correctly.json
--- parser
rc=0 perf=89 a11y=50 bp=99 seo=0 pwa=0
thresholds=1 failed=accessibility,seo

--- parse step exit=0
performance=89
accessibility=50
best-practices=99
seo=0
passed=false
failed-categories=accessibility,seo
